## Branch type

- [ ] `feature/*` → merge into **`dev`**
- [ ] `fix/*` → merge into **`dev`**
- [ ] `hotfix/*` → merge into **`prod`** (and back-merge to `dev` after)
- [ ] Release → merge **`dev`** into **`prod`**

## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is correct (`dev` for feature/fix, `prod` for hotfix)
- [ ] Branch name follows convention (`feature/`, `fix/`, or `hotfix/`)
- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] Hotfix: follow-up PR to `dev` planned or included

See [docs/git-workflow.md](../docs/git-workflow.md) for the full branching model.
